what_it_does: Designs a library of circuit building blocks (logic gates and other standard cells) optimized for ultra-low-voltage operation below 500 millivolts. Chip manufacturers provide standard libraries designed for normal operating voltages around 1.2 volts, but these perform poorly at lower voltages needed for extreme power savings. The paper uses an automated evolutionary algorithm to find the best transistor sizes for each gate at subthreshold voltages, creating a specialized library validated on processor designs and benchmark circuits.
